 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **correctly spelled** word among the options given is **"PSEUDONYM".**
 
• **"Pseudonym"** refers to a fictitious name, especially one used by an author.
 
• The **word is often used** when referring to pen names in literature.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: '**Pseudonym'.**

• **"CAMOFLAGUE"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is** "CAMOUFLAGE"**, which refers to the methods used by animals and military personnel to blend with their environment or disguise themselves.(छद्म वेश).
